headline: Jenna Bush Hager's 11-year-old daughter did not believe a photo of a falcon sitting on her mother's head was real and thought it was made with AI.
score_reason: Pure human-interest moment with a thin AI angle; the facts fit the pool score of 2.
importance_line: It is a light moment showing that people now suspect real photos of being AI-made, with nothing at stake and only the host's own on-air account as evidence.
summary: OK! Magazine, as carried by AOL, reports that Jenna Bush Hager, co-host of the TV show TODAY With Jenna and Sheinelle, said on the 16 Oct 2026 episode, broadcast live from Ireland, that her 11-year-old daughter Poppy thought a photo of a falcon landing on her head was made by AI. The bird landed there during a falconry session with co-host Sheinelle Jones, and Bush Hager asked on air, "when does a bird land on somebody's head?"
notes: AOL carries OK! Magazine's own text, so OK! is credited as the source; the AOL page is where the text was read.
